_comment: Active volcanoes inside the realtime watch bbox (WATCH_BBOXES default -170,15,-50,72). Incidents whose centroid lies within radiusKm of one are labelled 'Volcanic heat', ranked below wildfires and not briefed: lava lakes and eruptions are not wildfires. Selection: Holocene volcanoes with Last_Eruption_Year >= 2015 and not undersea.
source: Smithsonian Institution Global Volcanism Program, Volcanoes of the World (Holocene volcano list, WFS layer GVP-VOTW:Smithsonian_VOTW_Holocene_Volcanoes), https://volcano.si.edu/ , retrieved 2026-11-24. Coordinates and Last_Eruption_Year as published there.
radiusNote: Default 10 km (summit and flanks). Larger radii cover rift zones and extended flows: Kilauea 45 km (East Rift Zone vents sit ~40 km from the summit), Mauna Loa 30 km, Popocatepetl 15 km. Judgement, not a GVP value.
